title: 第9章 我拿件宝贝跟你换第10章 这就是所谓的盐吗
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
“那个猪王兽变得比巨人还大，我当时啥都没怕就冲了上去！”
“别听他说的那么神气，其实他是吓得连动都不敢动，还好小兄弟出手救了我们。”
“最吓人的还得数狮虎兽那场战斗，这小伙简直是勇猛无比啊！”
……
听着队友们互相调侃添油加醋地讲故事，小孩们不时发出惊叹声、笑声，给寒冷的夜晚增添了一丝丝温暖。
但今天的主要人物童元安并没有加入他们的聊天中。
现在他正在指挥部落里的女人们处理战利品，为接下来的一笔意外之财做准备。
“这里的食材真的丰富多汁，那些野兽肉肯定特别美味。”
童元安点头表示满意。
他打算举办一个自助烤肉晚宴，指导妇女们把肉切成块、洗干净。
同时，他也开始盘算如何把这些肉类带回地球上去了。
这里独特的生物种类在后世简直无处可寻，一旦带回现代世界，必定会引起不小的轰动。
整个准备工作井井有条地进行着，众人合力很快就把带回来的食物处理好了。
这时，铜木等人拿着一堆调料走过来。
但他们并不知道自己手中的是什么东西，完全是按照童元安的指示做的。
所使用的原料是从回程路上随手采来的植物。
“兄弟，你这是打算做什么呀？”
铜木好奇地问，并尝试了一口自己刚调配好的调料，结果差点把他呛死了，赶紧喝水才缓了过来。
“烹饪美味呢，等着吃吧！”
说着，童元安将一块块肉串起放到了火堆旁边，并撒上了各种调料。

很快，空气中弥漫起一阵浓郁的香味。
正在交谈的人们都停止了话题，纷纷闻香而至。
咕咚……
大家都迫不及待地围上前去，吞咽的声音此起彼伏。
没有人想到，美食的魅力连那些古老的存在也无法抗拒。
躲在暗处观察这一切的后土也被吸引了过去。
这种味道对她来说十分陌生又极具吸引力。
一些普通的野生动物经过烹调后竟然散发出如此诱人的香气，这个小伙子真是充满惊喜啊。
“嗯？怎么可能！”
突然，后土看到天空再次出现了金光云彩——这代表着获得了上天的认可！
一位普通人能够在短时间内得到两次这样的奖励实在罕见。
content_en:
"The pig king beast became bigger than a giant, and I rushed forward without any fear!"
"Don't listen to what he said, but he was actually so scared that he didn't even dare to move. Fortunately, my little brother rescued us."
"The most terrifying thing is the battle between the liger and the tiger. This guy is so brave!"
…
Listening to the teammates teasing each other and telling stories, the children exclaimed and laughed from time to time, adding a touch of warmth to the cold night.
But today's main character, Tong Yuanan, did not join their chat.
Now he is directing the women in the tribe to handle the loot and prepare for the next windfall.
"The ingredients here are really rich and juicy, and the beast meat must be particularly delicious."
Tong Yuanan nodded to express satisfaction.
He planned to hold a buffet barbecue dinner and instruct the women on how to cut and clean the meat.
At the same time, he also began to figure out how to bring the meat back to the earth.
The unique species of creatures here are simply nowhere to be found in later generations. Once brought back to the modern world, they will definitely cause quite a sensation.
The entire preparation work was carried out in an orderly manner, and everyone worked together to quickly process the food brought back.
At this time, Tongmu and others came over with a bunch of condiments.
But they didn't know what they had in their hands, and they did it exactly according to Tong Yuanan's instructions.
The raw materials used are plants picked randomly on the way back.
"Brother, what are you planning to do?"
Tongmu asked curiously, and took a sip of the condiment he had just prepared. He almost choked to death, and he quickly drank water to recover.
"The cooking is delicious, wait and eat!"
As he spoke, Tong Yuanan skewered pieces of meat and placed them next to the fire, and sprinkled them with various seasonings.
Soon, a strong fragrance filled the air.
People who were talking stopped talking and came to smell the fragrance one after another.
Gudong...
Everyone gathered around impatiently, and the sounds of swallowing came and went.
No one thought that even those ancient beings could not resist the charm of delicious food.
Hou Tu, who was hiding in the dark and observing all this, was also attracted.
This smell was very strange and attractive to her.
Some ordinary wild animals can emit such an alluring aroma after being cooked. This young man is really full of surprises.
"Huh? How is that possible!"
Suddenly, Hou Tu saw golden clouds appear again in the sky - this meant that he was recognized by God!
It is rare for an ordinary person to receive such awards twice in a short period of time.
